records.baselineBasis: last counter at or before phase start

definition: Root plus direct children only. Subtract saved per-log cumulative counters; never add prior phase totals. Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning. Counter boundaries use the saved as-of samples. Wall time includes builds, device/user waits and parallel activity, not net work or network time. CLI counts are explicit executable statements in shell tool calls, including help/failures, not success counts. Direct profiler calls are separate; investigator inventory matches are deduplicated by arguments and source task. No conversation text, billing estimate, or unexposed backend tokens. Historical project totals remain unknown.
baselineDescription: Last cumulative sample before current request (response_item/message/role=user)
